shared_elements: carved figures in low relief on a flat field
justification: Both surfaces show quadruped animals in profile with open jaws and include a horizontal band of repeated motifs, but these are generic correspondences available to almost any relief tradition. A is a single naturalistic narrative frieze of a chariot with horses, an archer and attacking lions with rich interaction between figures, while B is a vertical stack of isolated, highly schematic creatures (crouching quadrupeds, a bird, a snake-like form) beneath a row of repeated arch-shaped signs, with no interaction or narrative at all.
